content.short: Zenland is a decentralized escrow service and marketplace.
content.description: Zenland is a no-code smart contract platform that allows buyers and sellers of products or services to make safer deals. The safety comes from a smart contract, a simple programmable agreement between two parties that encodes the terms of the transaction. By removing the need for coding, Zenland enables non-technical users to create, deploy, and rely on an enforceable contract to govern their exchanges, reducing ambiguity and risk in commerce while keeping processes straightforward and accessible.
content.meta: Zenland is the first no-code smart contract platform for safe deals. Discover Zenland and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
